title: Enhanced mm2
body:
## Summary
Enhanced Kafka MirrorMaker 2 to handle two critical edge cases:
1. **Log truncation detection** — Fail-fast when retention policies purge messages before replication
2. **Topic reset recovery** — Graceful recovery when source topics are deleted and recreated

## My Code Changes (4 commits)
👉 **[View clean diff of only my changes](https://github.com/Pradeep32/kafka/compare/985bc99...enhanced-mm2)**

### Files Added/Modified
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `TruncationDetector.java` | Tracks expected vs actual offsets per partition |
| `LogTruncationException.java` | Custom exception for truncation fail-fast |
| `TopicResetHandler.java` | Recovers from OffsetOutOfRangeException after topic recreation |
| `MirrorSourceTask.java` | Integrated truncation + reset logic into poll() |

## Test Scenarios
- **Scenario 1:** Normal replication (1000 messages, offset verification)
- **Scenario 2:** Truncation detection (retention deletes messages before MM2 starts)
- **Scenario 3:** Topic reset (delete + recreate topic while MM2 paused)

Reviewers: Mickael Maison <mickael.maison@gmail.com>
